page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Main text in one column at right, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the text (Quidam/cū sub iecto, Notio, Quarta, et plurima terminationem, and a note at the top left). Greek and Latin mixed. Below the text, a short line "Aliud paradigma." and a Greek word at the far right.

main_text.p: ducitur, ὁ ναὸς νεὼς, ὁ λαὸς λεὼς, τὸ εὔγαιον Quidam cū a= εὐγεων. Sic igitur flectis λαός Attice, ὁ ὢ cuto:et λεὼς τ λεω, sicut τ Ἀπολλω, uel τ λεῶο poetice. τῶ λεῷ, τὸν λεὼν (uel λεώ sine ν apud antiquiores Atticos, sicut τὸν λαγὼ, τῶν ... ) τῶ λεῷ, τοῖν λεῷν. οἱ ὢ λεῷ, τ λεῶν, τοῖς λεῷς, τὲς λεώς. sic ἡ ἄλως, τῆς ἄλω, τῇ ἄλῳ. τὸ εὐγεων, τ εὐγεω, τῷ εὐγεῳ. in plurali, τὰ εὐγεω, non εὐγεα.

Notio. Pauca in oς huius ordinis, ut ἡ νόσος νῆσος νόσος fœminina sunt, innumera uero masculina. Et heteroclita quędam, ὁ δίφρος, τὰ δίφρα. ἡ τάρταρος, τὰ τάρτα-ρα. At in & neutra quartę declinationis sunt.
Quædam in oς purum cōtrahuntur, ὁ νόος νēς, τ νόυ νῦ, τῷ νόῳ νῷ, τ νόον νοῦ. sic ἀλκίνοος αὐτίνος, ἀλκίνυς, αὐτίνυς, &c.
main_text.head: QVARTA DECLINATIO.
main_text.p: Quarta. Quarta nomina crescentia omnium generum complectitur. et plurimarū terminationem ὁ ὢ ἥφος, τῆ ἥφος, τῷ ἥφοι, τὸν ἥφα. τὼ ὢ ἥφοε, τοῖν ἡρώοιν. οἱ ὢ ἥφες, τῶν ἡρώων, τοῖς ἥφοι, τὰς ἥφας.

page.notes: Greek text is heavily abbreviated and partly illegible in the scan; the left margin notes are partly illegible and transcribed approximately. Marginal note near the top left reads "Quidam" with "cū sub iecto" and similar; several Greek forms are uncertain. Far right bottom: a short Greek marking (ἡ ὢ) not transcribed with certainty.
